items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: But it's people like, uh, Red Tyler. Sure.

ctx.x: What was, what was the difference?

I don't really, well, he, I think he did it in the quality of the musician. If the musician was a, of the high quality reading popular thing. Let me, let me show you the difference. Okay. And I'm not ashamed to say that I played that for $8, and I graduated to $12, you know. But it's people like, uh, Red Tyler. Sure. Uh, and all those people who, uh, much older and veterans of, uh, World War II, and came from gateways and Groomwall School of Music and so forth. Ernest McElaine, the Davises. They're, uh, rocking…
